answer: A hostile operator thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The grove counter is kept in knoll and mirror shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 28 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
